body.x: eMEasure(www.etape16.com), which specializes in digital measuring device, unveiled "eTape16" at CES Unveiled, a pre-show of CES 2015 which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.eTape16 is a digital measuring tape which can retain last measurement with its dual memory. The unit can be changed to either US or metric, and it has useful features like centerline and rezero, which conventional measuring tapes cannot do. Bluetooth enabled, this smart measuring tape finally changed the way of measuring from analog to digital.
